schemes.title: Chief Minister's Comprehensive Health Insurance Scheme (CMCHIS Card)
schemes.department: Health and Family Welfare Department, Tamil Nadu Health Systems Project (TNHSP)
schemes.brief: Free, cashless hospital treatment for low-income families in Tamil Nadu, at government hospitals and empanelled private hospitals, up to Rs 5 lakh per family a year. In Tamil Nadu it runs together with Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY (CMCHIS-PMJAY), so one card covers both. In August 2026 the Chief Minister announced that the yearly cover will rise to Rs 25 lakh; ask the helpline whether the higher cover has started. You enrol once, at the CMCHIS card centre in the District Collector's office.
schemes.benefit: Up to Rs 5 lakh a year per family, cashless (Rs 25 lakh cover announced in August 2026)
eligibility: Annual family income below Rs 1,20,000, certified by the Village Administrative Officer (VAO)
The family holds a Tamil Nadu ration (smart family) card, and everyone to be covered is named on it
Covers the head of the family, the legal spouse, children and dependent parents

Some groups join with their own ID card instead of an income certificate: differently-abled card holders, old-age and widow pensioners, handloom workers' board members, recognised journalists, transgender persons, Sri Lankan Tamil refugees and orphans
There is no age limit, and the family pays no premium
documents: Filled CMCHIS enrolment form
Income certificate from the VAO showing a yearly family income under Rs 1,20,000 (the VAO can also sign the box on the form itself)
Original family ration (smart) card
Aadhaar cards of the head of the family and of the members to be covered
A working mobile number
For the special groups: the welfare board, pension or other ID card in place of the income certificate
schemes.submitAt: The CMCHIS card centre (enrolment kiosk) at your District Collector's office. The head of the family should go in person with the filled form, the VAO income certificate, the original ration card and the Aadhaar cards of all members; the photo and fingerprint are taken there.

demoFields.label: Name of the head of the family
demoFields.hint: Write the name exactly as it is printed first on your ration card.

demoFields.label: Father's / husband's name
demoFields.hint: For a married woman who heads the family, write the husband's name.

demoFields.label: Gender, date of birth / age
demoFields.hint: Copy the date of birth from Aadhaar. If you do not know it, write the age in years.

demoFields.label: Occupation
demoFields.hint: Your main work, in simple words, for example coolie, weaver, auto driver or homemaker.

demoFields.label: Ration card number and ration shop number
demoFields.hint: Both numbers are on the smart card. The kiosk checks this number online, so copy it carefully.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar card number
demoFields.hint: Aadhaar of the head of the family. Members' Aadhaar is checked at the kiosk.

demoFields.label: Permanent address (door, street, village, taluk, district, PIN)
demoFields.value: 12, Kovil Street, Sevalpatti village, Peraiyur taluk, Madurai 625799
demoFields.hint: The address on the ration card. Write the village, taluk and district in full.

demoFields.label: Phone number
demoFields.hint: A number you always keep with you. Messages about the card and hospital approvals come here.

demoFields.label: Family members (name, age, gender, relation)
demoFields.value: Lakshmi, 42, F, wife; Karthik, 17, M, son; Ponnammal, 68, F, mother
demoFields.hint: List everyone to be covered. Only people named on the ration card can be added.

demoFields.label: VAO income certificate (box at the bottom)
demoFields.value: Annual family income Rs 84,000, signed and sealed by the VAO
demoFields.hint: The VAO writes the yearly income, signs and puts the office seal. It must be below Rs 1,20,000.

demoSteps: Download the CMCHIS enrolment form or collect it at the kiosk, and fill in the head of the family, the ration card and Aadhaar numbers and every member to be covered.

Take the form to your Village Administrative Officer, who certifies the yearly family income in the box at the bottom. It must be under Rs 1,20,000. An income certificate made through e-Sevai also works.

Go to the CMCHIS card centre at the District Collector's office with the form, the original ration card and all members' Aadhaar cards. The staff check the ration card online, take the photo and fingerprint and note your enrolment number.

Collect the CMCHIS card. You can later download the e-card from the CMCHIS website by searching with your ration card number. The website also has a CMCHIS-PMJAY Apply Now page where you can enrol online with the ration card number and an uploaded income certificate.

When you need treatment, go to a government or empanelled private hospital and show the card and ration card at the CMCHIS desk. The hospital takes approval from the insurer and you pay nothing for a covered treatment.
If a hospital asks for money for a covered treatment, or the card is not accepted, call the toll-free helpline 1800 425 3993 at once.
schemes.helpline: 1800 425 3993 — CMCHIS 24x7 toll-free helpline / 14555 — Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY national helpline

schemes.title: Moovalur Ramamirtham Ammaiyar Higher Education Assurance Scheme (Pudhumai Penn)
schemes.department: Social Welfare and Women Empowerment Department, Government of Tamil Nadu (with the Higher Education Department)
schemes.brief: Rs 1,000 every month, paid straight into the bank account, for girls who studied Classes 6 to 12 in a Tamil Nadu government school and have joined college. It is paid until they finish their first degree, diploma or ITI course, on top of any other scholarship. Officially it is the Moovalur Ramamirtham Ammaiyar Higher Education Assurance Scheme, which replaced the old Moovalur Ramamirtham marriage assistance scheme, and since December 2024 girls from government-aided schools are covered too. You apply through your college, which enters your details on the UMIS portal.
schemes.benefit: Rs 1,000 a month by DBT until the first higher-education course is finished
eligibility: Girl who studied Classes 6 to 12 in a Tamil Nadu government school, or in a government-aided school (added in December 2024)
Now studying in a recognised college, university, polytechnic or ITI
Only the first higher-education course counts; a second degree is not paid
No family income limit, and any number of girls in one family can get it
It can be taken along with other scholarships
Bank account in the student's own name, linked with Aadhaar
documents: Aadhaar card of the student
Bank passbook of an account in the student's own name, linked with Aadhaar (the college helps open a zero-balance account)
10th and 12th mark sheets
Transfer certificate from the school, showing study in a government or government-aided school
EMIS number from your school
College admission slip or bonafide certificate
A working mobile number
schemes.submitAt: Your college's Pudhumai Penn nodal officer, usually in the scholarship section, in the first weeks of the course. Take your Aadhaar, bank passbook, 10th and 12th mark sheets, school transfer certificate and EMIS number; the nodal officer enters and verifies your details on the UMIS portal.

demoFields.label: Student name (as in Aadhaar)
demoFields.hint: Write the name exactly as in Aadhaar, or the money will not reach the bank account.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar number
demoFields.hint: The student's own Aadhaar, not a parent's.

demoFields.label: EMIS number
demoFields.hint: Your student ID from the school's EMIS records. Ask your old school if you do not have it.

demoFields.label: School where you studied Classes 6 to 12
demoFields.value: Government Girls Higher Secondary School, Vellaimalai
demoFields.hint: Name every school if you changed schools. All must be government or government-aided schools.

demoFields.label: College name
demoFields.value: Government Arts and Science College, Pudhur
demoFields.hint: The college where you are studying now.

demoFields.label: Course and year of admission
demoFields.hint: Only your first course after school is eligible.

demoFields.label: Admission or roll number
demoFields.hint: From your college ID card or admission slip.

demoFields.label: Mobile number
demoFields.hint: Your own number. Messages about the scheme come here.

demoFields.label: Bank account number
demoFields.hint: An account in your own name, linked with your Aadhaar.

demoFields.label: IFSC code
demoFields.hint: Printed on the first page of the passbook.

demoSteps: After joining college, meet the Pudhumai Penn nodal officer in the scholarship section during the first weeks.
Hand over your Aadhaar, bank passbook, 10th and 12th mark sheets, school transfer certificate and EMIS number. If you have no bank account, open a zero-balance account through the college.
The nodal officer enters your details on the UMIS portal, where your schooling is matched with the EMIS records. Ask for your UMIS ID or application number and keep it safe.
Once approved, Rs 1,000 comes into your bank account every month by DBT.
Every six months, on 30 June and 31 December, the college confirms that you are still studying. The payment continues only while you stay on the rolls.
If the money stops, first check at your bank that Aadhaar is linked to the account, then ask the nodal officer to check your record on UMIS.
schemes.helpline: Your college's Pudhumai Penn nodal officer / District Social Welfare Officer at the Collectorate / 1100 — Tamil Nadu citizen helpline for complaints

It is the boys' version of Pudhumai Penn, started in August 2024, and is paid until the first degree, diploma or ITI course is finished, on top of other scholarships. You apply through your college, which enters your details on the UMIS portal.

schemes.title: Dr Muthulakshmi Reddy Maternity Benefit Scheme (Rs 18,000 for Pregnant Women)
schemes.department: Directorate of Public Health and Preventive Medicine, Health and Family Welfare Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
schemes.brief: Rs 18,000 for a pregnant woman in Tamil Nadu: Rs 14,000 in three cash instalments into her own bank account, and two nutrition kits worth Rs 2,000 each. You register the pregnancy with the Village Health Nurse (VHN) and get a 12-digit PICME (RCH) number, and the VHN files the application before delivery; the same application also covers the central PM Matru Vandana Yojana. For the later instalments the delivery must be in a government hospital and the baby's vaccines must be on time.
schemes.benefit: Rs 18,000 — Rs 14,000 cash in 3 instalments plus 2 nutrition kits of Rs 2,000
eligibility: Pregnant woman aged 18 to 55 living in Tamil Nadu, with the pregnancy registered on PICME
Given for the first two deliveries; for a third or later child, only if the mother or husband has had a permanent sterilisation
Neither the mother nor the husband is a government employee
The application must be made before delivery; the first instalment starts about 4 months (120 days) after the last period
Delivery in a government hospital, at least two antenatal check-ups and the baby's vaccines on time are needed for the later instalments
Bank account in the mother's own name, linked with her Aadhaar
documents: Mother's Aadhaar card
Bank passbook of an account in the mother's own name, linked with Aadhaar
PICME (RCH) number and the Mother and Child Protection (MCP) card given at registration
Proof of current address
One PMMVY proof, such as the ration card, CMCHIS or Ayushman card, MGNREGA job card or e-Shram card
Husband's name, both parents' occupations and a mobile number
schemes.portalName: PICME (Pregnancy and Infant Cohort Monitoring and Evaluation)
schemes.submitAt: Register the pregnancy with the Village Health Nurse at your Health Sub Centre or at the nearest Primary Health Centre (in towns, the Urban Primary Health Centre), as early as possible and ideally before 12 weeks. Take your Aadhaar, bank passbook, ration card and address proof; the VHN gives the PICME (RCH) number and enters the maternity benefit application on the PICME portal before delivery.

demoFields.label: RCH (PICME) ID
demoFields.hint: The 12-digit number you get when the pregnancy is registered. Every payment is linked to it.

demoFields.label: Beneficiary name
demoFields.hint: The mother's name exactly as in her Aadhaar.

demoFields.label: Husband's name
demoFields.hint: As in the husband's Aadhaar or the ration card.

demoFields.label: Last menstrual period (LMP) date
demoFields.hint: First day of your last period. The due date and instalment dates are worked out from this.

demoFields.label: Mother's date of birth and age
demoFields.hint: From Aadhaar. The mother must be between 18 and 55.

demoFields.label: Gravida (which pregnancy)
demoFields.hint: Count every pregnancy, including this one. The benefit is for the first two deliveries.

demoFields.label: Occupation of mother and husband
demoFields.hint: Must be filled for both. Government employees are not eligible.

demoFields.label: Mother's bank account number
demoFields.hint: Her own account, linked with her Aadhaar. A joint or husband's account is not accepted.

demoFields.label: Current address
demoFields.value: 5, Nehru Street, Kalavoor, Usilampatti taluk, Madurai district
demoFields.hint: Where you live now. Upload or show proof of this address.

demoFields.label: PMMVY proof type and number
demoFields.hint: One document such as the ration card, CMCHIS or Ayushman card, job card or e-Shram card.

demoSteps: As soon as you know you are pregnant, go to the Village Health Nurse at the Health Sub Centre or PHC and register. You get the MCP card and the 12-digit PICME (RCH) number.

Give the VHN your Aadhaar, bank passbook, address proof and one PMMVY proof. She enters the application on PICME before delivery, and it is checked by the Sector Health Nurse, the PHC Medical Officer and the Block Medical Officer.
Collect the first nutrition kit at the PHC around the third month. After the fourth month of pregnancy, the first instalment of Rs 6,000 comes into your account.
Go for at least two antenatal check-ups and have the delivery in a government hospital. Get the baby's birth-dose vaccines (BCG, OPV, Hepatitis B) before leaving the hospital.
About four months after delivery, once the baby's vaccines up to 14 weeks are done, the second instalment of Rs 6,000 is paid.
After the measles-rubella (MR) vaccine at 9 months, the last Rs 2,000 is paid. The second nutrition kit is given at the PHC as well.
If a payment is late, ask your VHN first, or call the PICME helpdesk with your RCH number.
schemes.helpline: 044-29510307 / 94890 48910 — PICME helpdesk, Directorate of Public Health / 102 — free ambulance and pregnancy help

schemes.title: Tamil Nadu Construction Workers Welfare Board Registration (Construction Worker Card)
schemes.department: Tamil Nadu Construction Workers Welfare Board, Labour Welfare and Skill Development Department
schemes.brief: Registering with the Tamil Nadu Construction Workers Welfare Board gives masons, helpers, carpenters, painters, plumbers, electricians and other building workers a registration card that unlocks the board's benefits: education help for children, marriage and maternity money, a monthly pension at 60, accident and death cover, and help to build a house. Registration, renewal and claims are free and done online on the Unorganised Workers Welfare Boards portal, using your mobile number and ration card number. The Assistant Commissioner of Labour (Social Security Scheme) checks the application, and the permanent registration number comes by SMS.
schemes.benefit: Pension Rs 1,200 a month at 60; marriage Rs 20,000; maternity Rs 18,000; up to Rs 5 lakh on death at a worksite
eligibility: Age 18 to 60
Working in one of the 54 construction trades listed by the board, such as mason, helper, carpenter, painter, plumber, electrician, bar bender, tile layer, or road and well work
A work certificate in the board's format, signed by an employer, registered contractor, registered trade union office-bearer, the VAO (Revenue Inspector in Chennai) or a labour inspector
Not a member of any other welfare board
Resident of Tamil Nadu with a ration card; workers from other states register separately on the same portal
Registration and all claims are free; renew the registration on time or benefits stop
documents: Work certificate in the board's format, signed by the employer, union, contractor or VAO
Age proof: driving licence, school certificate, voter ID or a doctor's certificate
Ration (smart family) card
Aadhaar card
First page of the bank passbook
Proof of relationship with the nominee
Recent passport-size photo
schemes.portalName: Tamil Nadu Unorganised Workers Welfare Boards portal

demoFields.label: Mobile number
demoFields.hint: Your own number. Until the officer approves, you can log in only with the OTP sent here.

demoFields.label: Ration card / smart card number
demoFields.hint: From your family smart card. Family members are taken from this card.

demoFields.label: OTP
demoFields.hint: Type it within the time shown, or press Resend OTP.

demoFields.label: Welfare board
demoFields.value: Tamil Nadu Construction Workers Welfare Board
demoFields.hint: Choose the construction board, not the manual workers' board.

demoFields.label: Nature of work
demoFields.hint: Pick the trade written on your work certificate.

demoFields.label: Name and father's / husband's name
demoFields.hint: As in Aadhaar.

demoFields.label: Date of birth
demoFields.hint: From the age proof you upload. You must be between 18 and 60.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar number
demoFields.hint: Your own Aadhaar.

demoFields.label: Bank account number and IFSC
demoFields.hint: An account in your own name. Every benefit is paid into it.

demoFields.label: Nominee and family members (name, relation, age)
demoFields.value: Valli A, wife, 38; Divya A, daughter, 15
demoFields.hint: Enter every member with the correct age. Education and marriage help for children is decided by age.

demoSteps: Get the work certificate filled and signed in the board's format by your employer, union, contractor or VAO, and keep photos or scans of all documents ready.
Open the portal, click New Registration, enter your mobile number and ration card number and verify the OTP.
Choose the Construction Workers Welfare Board and your trade, fill in your personal, bank, nominee and family details, upload the documents and submit. The application number comes by SMS.
The Assistant Commissioner of Labour (Social Security Scheme) office checks it. If anything is missing you get an SMS: log in with OTP, correct it and submit again.
On approval, the permanent registration number and password come by SMS. Log in and download your registration certificate.
For each benefit, such as education help, marriage, maternity or the pension at 60, log in and file a Claim with the proof. The money is paid into your bank account.
Renew the registration on the portal before it expires so that your benefits continue.
schemes.helpline: No toll-free number: call or visit the Assistant Commissioner of Labour (Social Security Scheme) office in your district; complaints can also be filed under Grievance Form on the board's portal

schemes.title: Tamil Nadu Social Security Pension (Old Age, Widow and Disability Pension)
schemes.department: Revenue and Disaster Management Department (Social Security Scheme), Government of Tamil Nadu
schemes.brief: A monthly pension from the Tamil Nadu government for poor elderly people, widows, deserted women, unmarried poor women over 50, landless farm workers over 60 and persons with disabilities. Most get Rs 1,200 a month, and persons with disabilities get Rs 1,500, paid into the bank account; the central old-age, widow and disability pensions are included in this amount. You apply online through e-Sevai, yourself or at an e-Sevai centre. The VAO and Revenue Inspector verify the application, and the Special Tahsildar (Social Security Scheme) at the taluk office sanctions it.
schemes.benefit: Rs 1,200 a month (Rs 1,500 for persons with disabilities)
eligibility: Old age pension: aged 60 or above, destitute and from a below-poverty-line family
Widow pension: a destitute widow aged 18 or above
Disability pension: 40% disability or more, aged 18 or above, and unemployed or earning under Rs 3 lakh a year
Also for deserted women aged 30 or above, unmarried poor women aged 50 or above, and landless farm workers aged 60 or above (Chief Minister's Uzhavar Pathukappu scheme)
Immovable property worth no more than Rs 1,00,000, not counting a house given free by the government
Not drawing any other government pension
documents: Aadhaar card
Ration (smart family) card
Age proof, such as a birth certificate, school certificate or a doctor's age certificate
Bank passbook of an account in the applicant's own name
Recent passport-size photo
Husband's death certificate for a widow, or the disability certificate or UDID card for a person with disability

demoFields.label: CAN number
demoFields.hint: Your Common Account Number on e-Sevai. If you have none, create it free with your Aadhaar and mobile number first.

demoFields.label: Pension scheme
demoFields.value: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme
demoFields.hint: Choose old age, widow, disability, deserted women, unmarried women or Uzhavar Pathukappu, whichever fits you.

demoFields.label: Applicant name
demoFields.hint: As in Aadhaar.

demoFields.label: Date of birth and age
demoFields.hint: From the age proof you upload.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar number
demoFields.hint: The applicant's own Aadhaar.

demoFields.label: Ration card number
demoFields.hint: From the family smart card.

demoFields.label: Monthly income and property value
demoFields.value: No regular income; no land or house of her own
demoFields.hint: Write the truth. The VAO checks this, and property above Rs 1 lakh, apart from a free government house, makes you ineligible.

demoFields.label: Bank account number and IFSC
demoFields.hint: An account in the applicant's own name. The pension is paid here every month.

demoFields.label: Address (village, taluk, district)
demoFields.value: 3, Mariamman Kovil Street, Keezhapudur, Paramakudi taluk, Ramanathapuram
demoFields.hint: Where you live now. The VAO of this village does the verification.

demoFields.label: Documents to upload
demoFields.value: Aadhaar, ration card, photo, age proof
demoFields.hint: Clear photos or scans. A widow adds the husband's death certificate; a person with disability adds the disability certificate.

demoSteps: Log in on the e-Sevai citizen portal with your CAN number, or go to any e-Sevai centre, where the operator applies for you.
Choose the Revenue Department social security pension service, pick the right scheme, fill in the details and upload the documents.
Submit and keep the application number from the receipt or SMS.
The VAO and the Revenue Inspector visit or call to check your age, income and property, and the Special Tahsildar (Social Security Scheme) at the taluk office decides.
Once sanctioned, the pension is paid into your bank account every month. You can check the status on e-Sevai with the application number.
If it is rejected or delayed, meet the Special Tahsildar (Social Security Scheme) at the taluk office, or complain on the 1100 helpline.
schemes.helpline: 1100 — Tamil Nadu citizen helpline / Special Tahsildar (Social Security Scheme) at your taluk office
